required_context: Distinguish the roadway from its shoulder and preserve trail access restrictions and relevant exceptions without assuming motorized access.
Establish connections among the nonmotorized trail, sidewalk and associated roadway.
Establish connections among the trail, sidewalk and roadway and retain their separate boundaries and purposes.
Establish sidewalk purpose, extent, roadway boundaries and shoulder exclusions.
Establish the provided sidewalk's extent and pedestrian-use purpose and the afoot route's roadway occupancy, heading, distance and timing.
Preserve municipal definition applicability, map-support uncertainty and the unresolved state-law obstruction permission and interaction; choose no legal movement cutoff.
Preserve trail access restrictions and any relevant exceptions without assuming motorized access.
Retain map-support, municipal-definition and state-law interaction uncertainties.
Route an afoot ego along and upon the roadway beside the provided sidewalk.
